scripts.db:push: node -e "import('child_process').then(cp => { const url = process.env.DATABASE_URL || ''; if (url.startsWith('postgres://') || url.startsWith('postgresql://')) { cp.execSync('npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { console.log('Skipping db:push: DATABASE_URL is not PostgreSQL.'); } })"
